description:
src/types.rs:60, 120, 175. BodyType, ChatMemberRole, and QuotaScope are string-shaped wire enums with Unknown(String)/Other(String) catch-alls, matching the workspace 'in-scope result enum' pattern from AGENTS.md 'Extras-preservation policy'. Policy mandates: 'For result enums, the test asserts an unknown wire string deserialises into Unknown(s) and round-trips back to the same wire string.' None of these enums have such a test in types.rs.

The enum bodies are unchanged by the diff under review (so technically out-of-diff), but the policy applies and this is the right crate-scope review to surface it. Suggest filing as a child of JMAP-lbdy if not already covered. Test shape: serialize_then_deserialize on a non-spec wire string like "application/x-acme".
title: BodyType/ChatMemberRole/QuotaScope wire enums lack round-trip preservation tests
